description.en: Layer on layer of cut paper, real paper texture and soft shadows.
description.tr: Katman katman kesik kağıt, gerçek kağıt dokusu ve yumuşak gölgeler.

colorRules.ochre: the highlight: key bar, sun, the element that matters
colorRules.deepBlue: only as the inner, lower layer seen through cut-outs
colorRules.paperLight: paper inside icons, documents, play triangles

display.use: headlines and numbers, rendered as cut paper letters with their own shadow

paper.cutOuts: holes in a top layer reveal a darker layer below

camera.view: flat front view, no perspective, no depth of field

enter.type: layers slide in from off-frame or flip up from behind, one layer at a time, back to front

motion.lift: on accents a layer lifts: its shadow grows and softens, then settles
motion.sway: hanging or loose pieces sway slightly, seeded, small amplitude

exit.type: slide off frame or fold down

motion.transition: a large paper sheet slides across the frame and becomes the next background
